about: The name decoder's recogniser (tracker Ocr/NameDecoder.cs). Not committed and not built into the exe: `node tools/data/models.js` downloads each file from its pinned URL, checks its SHA-256 and writes it to the tracker's kept data folder, %LOCALAPPDATA%/KinahLedger/data (or --out). The tracker loads a file only when its SHA-256 matches this list.

name-rec.onnx.source: PaddleOCR en_PP-OCRv4 mobile text recognition (Apache-2.0), ONNX export by CnOCR

name-rec-dict.txt.source: PaddleOCR ppocr/utils/en_dict.txt (Apache-2.0): the model's 95 characters, one per line
